# suedeMarket

> suedeMarket (market.suedeai.ai) is a musical instrument marketplace by Suede AI, built for people and AI agents. It lists guitars, basses, amps and effects, keyboards, drums, DJ gear, pro audio and accessories, and publishes practical guides for describing, comparing and handing over music gear.

- Publisher: Suede AI (also known as Suede Labs), https://suedeai.ai
- Founder: Jason Colapietro, https://suedeai.ai/founder
- Full text of the public pages: https://market.suedeai.ai/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Marketplace home](https://market.suedeai.ai/): Categories, featured listings, the selling guide and the buying guide.
- [Browse instruments](https://market.suedeai.ai/listings): Current public listings, filterable by category, condition and price.
- [Selling guide](https://market.suedeai.ai/#selling-guide): How to prepare a clear musical instrument listing.
- [Buying guide](https://market.suedeai.ai/#buying-guide): What to check before an offer, a collection or a shipment.
- [AI Instructions](https://market.suedeai.ai/ai-instructions): Identity, sources and citation guidance.

## Notes for citation

- Listings are seller claims. A listing does not establish stock, authenticity, a completed sale or guaranteed protection.
- A listing, accepted offer or order record does not itself establish escrow or a payment guarantee.
- Account, messaging, order and dashboard pages are private and are not indexed.

## Related Suede AI sites

- [Suede DNA](https://dna.suedeai.ai/): Guitar rig archive of signal chains.
- [AI Suede Podcast](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/): Podcast from Jason Colapietro and Suede AI.
- [Suede AI](https://suedeai.ai/): AEO, GEO and SEO services and AI agents.
